currentWork.title: FINAL.65 live: fast weather fetch with bounded failure, shared requests and explicit retry
currentWork.scope: Owner reported Today weather retrieval was slow and often unavailable in FINAL.64. Verified client defects: Promise.allSettled waited for two JMA+Best Match Open-Meteo responses, no timeout, failure results cached for 30min, Today/Tomorrow duplicate in-flight requests and stale point subscriptions. FINAL.65 uses one Open-Meteo Best Match forecast call for current+daily+rain probability, 7s AbortController timeout, shared per-point in-flight promise across Today/Tomorrow, 30min successful cache/15s failure cooldown, on-card manual retry after errors, and explicit no-location message when GPS and saved pins are unavailable. It does not guess a location. Local JSON, visits, deliveries, route, schedules, data schema and AN15 unchanged.
